title: Design embodied visionOS, Android XR, Horizon OS, and WebXR interfaces with comfort, ergonomics, and gaze privacy

contextSnapshot.platform: visionOS 2/26 / Android XR (Compose for XR) / Meta Horizon OS / WebXR
constraints: comfortable viewing distance and angular text size

prompt: Design a mixed-reality workspace for inspecting architectural models across visionOS and Android XR, covering ornaments/orbiters, depth ergonomics, locomotion comfort, and spatial accessibility.
forbiddenBehaviors: forces involuntary camera movement or omits seated/low-motion comfort alternatives
transplants a miniature flat desktop dashboard into space without angular legibility, hover/pinch feedback, or depth hierarchy
claims comfort, stereo convergence, or frame stability are verified from a 2D desktop simulator screenshot

rubricDimensions.pass: uses native spatial primitives (visionOS ornaments/volumes/SpatialLayout, Android XR Subspace/SpatialPanel/Orbiter, Horizon OS MRUK, or @react-three/xr v6 + WebXR Layers)
rubricDimensions.fail: places flat unergonomic panes randomly in space or conflates ordinary browser 3D with embodied XR

rubricDimensions.pass: calculates viewing distance/angular size, preserves user camera control, discloses gaze/passthrough/room telemetry minimization, and provides seated/one-handed/reduced-motion alternatives
rubricDimensions.fail: ignores motion sickness, frame headroom, gaze privacy, or non-head-aimed accessibility

negativeControls.name: 2d simulator screenshot
negativeControls.input: the scene renders cleanly in Xcode visionOS Simulator or desktop Chrome
negativeControls.mustNot: declare XR comfort, stereo depth convergence, input fatigue, or headset frame pacing verified

baseline.withoutSkill: floats glass panels across a wide FOV with tiny text, ignores Android XR and comfort controls, and treats simulator screenshots as headset proof
baseline.withSkill: applies native spatial primitives, ergonomic viewing envelopes, locomotion/comfort settings, gaze/room privacy guardrails, and honest headset not-checked labels
